newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks close lower after quiet JR West debut.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks close lower after quiet JR West debut.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed lower in subdued trading on Tuesday, with investors' attention on the lacklustre debut of West Japan Railway Co.
Brokers said sluggishness would linger until Japan's political climate becomes clear after general elections on October 20.
The key 225-share Nikkei average was down 122.48 points or 0.58 percent to close at 21,038.53. Its December futures shed 170 points to 21,030.
"The Nikkei average is not likely to break out of the current range for the time being," said Tetsuya Ishijima, chief strategist at Okasan Securities Co Ltd.
